title: Air Force Academy friend flew a back-engineered UFO-like craft

as_told.title: Friend's account of back-engineered and flown craft

plain: An old friend from the Air Force Academy has actually flown a craft similar to a UFO, says Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer. He tells Michels that this personal contact has convinced him the United States has recovered crashed craft and "back engineered" them, meaning taken them apart to learn how to build copies, and has even flown some models. If so, human pilots are already flying machines based on non-human technology.
